bed.definition: A piece of furniture for lying on and sleeping.
bed.exampleUsage: The bed is beside the window.

nightstand.definition: A small table or cabinet beside a bed.
nightstand.exampleUsage: My phone is on the nightstand.

dresser.definition: A chest of drawers for clothes in the American bedroom sense.
dresser.exampleUsage: Folded shirts are in the dresser.

wardrobe.definition: A cupboard for hanging or storing clothes.
wardrobe.exampleUsage: My coat is in the wardrobe.

desk.definition: A table used for writing or working.

chair.definition: A seat for one person, usually with a back.
chair.exampleUsage: The chair is beside the desk.

bookshelf.definition: A shelf or set of shelves for books.
bookshelf.exampleUsage: The books are on the bookshelf.

mirror.definition: A surface that reflects an image.
mirror.exampleUsage: The mirror hangs on the wall.

stool.definition: A seat without a back in this context.
stool.exampleUsage: The stool stands below the mirror.

chest-of-drawers.definition: Furniture with several drawers for storing clothes or other items.
chest-of-drawers.exampleUsage: Socks are in the chest of drawers.

pillow.definition: A soft support for your head when resting.
pillow.exampleUsage: The pillow is on the bed.

blanket.definition: A covering used to keep someone warm.

sheet.definition: A thin piece of cloth used as bed linen.
sheet.exampleUsage: Put a clean sheet on the mattress.

mattress.definition: A padded support placed on a bed for sleeping.
mattress.exampleUsage: The mattress rests on the bed frame.

duvet.definition: A filled bed covering, often used inside a removable cover.
duvet.exampleUsage: The duvet has a blue cover.

pillowcase.definition: A removable cloth cover for a pillow.

comforter.definition: A thick filled bed covering, especially in American English.

cushion.definition: A soft pad used on a seat or for decoration.
cushion.exampleUsage: The cushion is on the chair.

bed-frame.exampleUsage: The bed frame supports the mattress.

headboard.definition: The board or panel at the head of a bed.
headboard.exampleUsage: The headboard is against the wall.

lamp.exampleUsage: The lamp is on the table.

curtain.definition: A hanging cloth used to cover a window.

window.definition: An opening in a wall, usually fitted with glass.
window.exampleUsage: The window looks onto the garden.

door.definition: A movable panel that opens or closes an entrance.

rug.definition: A movable floor covering, usually smaller than the floor.
rug.exampleUsage: A rug lies beside the bed.

carpet.definition: A textile floor covering; here it covers the room floor.

ceiling-light.definition: A light fixture attached to the ceiling.

light-switch.definition: A control used to turn a light on or off.
light-switch.exampleUsage: The light switch is beside the door.

blinds.definition: Window coverings made of adjustable strips or a roll of material.

outlet.definition: An electrical socket in American English.
outlet.exampleUsage: The outlet is on the wall.

alarm-clock.definition: A clock that gives a signal at a chosen time.
alarm-clock.exampleUsage: My alarm clock rings at seven.

picture-frame.definition: A border or support that holds a picture.
picture-frame.exampleUsage: The picture frame stands on the shelf.

clock.definition: A device that shows the time.

plant.definition: A living plant kept indoors in this context.
plant.exampleUsage: The plant is near the window.

vase.definition: A container used to display flowers.

candle.definition: Wax with a wick that can burn to produce light.
candle.exampleUsage: The unlit candle stands on a safe surface.

calendar.definition: A display of days, weeks and months.

tissue-box.definition: A container for disposable paper tissues.
tissue-box.exampleUsage: The tissue box is on the desk.

wastebasket.exampleUsage: Put the used tissue in the wastebasket.

hanger.definition: A shaped support for hanging clothes.
hanger.exampleUsage: The shirt is on a hanger.

pajamas.exampleUsage: My pajamas are in the drawer.

slippers.exampleUsage: My slippers are beside the bed.

robe.definition: A loose garment worn at home over other clothes.
robe.exampleUsage: The robe hangs behind the door.

teddy-bear.definition: A soft toy shaped like a bear.
teddy-bear.exampleUsage: The teddy bear was a gift.

poster.definition: A large printed picture or notice for display.

books.definition: Bound or electronic works containing writing or pictures.
books.exampleUsage: Two books are on the desk.

photo-album.definition: A book or collection used to keep photographs.
photo-album.exampleUsage: The photo album is on the shelf.

glasses.definition: Lenses worn in a frame to help vision in this context.
glasses.exampleUsage: My glasses are beside the book.

backpack.definition: A bag carried on the back with shoulder straps.
backpack.exampleUsage: The backpack is ready for work.

jewelry-box.exampleUsage: The ring is in the jewelry box.

phone.definition: A device used for calls and communication.
phone.exampleUsage: My phone is on the nightstand.

charger.definition: A device that supplies energy to a rechargeable battery.
charger.exampleUsage: The charger is beside the laptop.

laptop.definition: A portable computer with an attached screen and keyboard.
laptop.exampleUsage: The laptop is on the desk.

headphones.definition: A pair of devices worn over or in the ears to hear sound.
headphones.exampleUsage: The headphones are beside the tablet.

tablet.definition: A portable touchscreen computer in this context.
tablet.exampleUsage: The tablet has a blank screen.

reading-light.definition: A lamp used to provide light for reading.
reading-light.exampleUsage: The reading light is beside my chair.

remote-control.definition: A handheld device for operating equipment from a distance.
remote-control.exampleUsage: The remote control is beside the television.
